title: Practice 2: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural: работал, работала, работало, работали. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural: работал, работала, работало, работали.

exercises.prompt: You will drive me mad.
exercises.why: In a sentence referring to the future with a subordinate clause introduced by "when" or "as soon as" the verbs of both clauses are in the future: *Я буду читать письма, когда ты будешь учить диалог.* An action of the subordinate clause which is to be completed before the action of the main clause is rendered by the perfective future: *Когда я сделаю уроки, я буду слушать радио. Как только я получу от него письмо, я напишу вам.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: In a sentence referring to the future with a subordinate clause introduced by "when" or "as soon as" the verbs of both clauses are in the future: *Я буду читать письма,…

exercises.prompt: Drop everything and get over here.
exercises.why: The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs. It is formed from the 3rd person plural of the present tense or the perfective future by dropping the ending (-ют, -ут, -ят, -ат) and adding the endings of the imperative: After two or more consonants the imperative has always the ending -и(те) regardless of the stress: смотрите, помните. 2. Imperfective verbs of the type of давать, вставать, which drop the suffix «ва» in the present tense, restore it in the imperative: давайте, вставайте. — DLI, Lessons 42 and 84.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.
